children: LCI Industries voluntarily withdrew and refiled its HSR notification in connection with the merger with Patrick Industries, restarting the antitrust waiting period.
LCI Industries and Patrick Industries filed HSR notifications on Aug 5, 2026 for their planned mergers.
LCI withdrew its HSR notification on Sept 4, 2026 and refiled on Sept 9, 2026, initiating a new HSR waiting period.
Expiration/termination of the HSR waiting period is a condition to closing; other closing conditions remain outstanding.
Mergers involve two-step structure: first merging First Merger Sub into LCI, then LCI into Second Merger Sub, becoming Patrick subsidiaries.
